claims.head: The Flyers feed on mistakes, and the Kraken make them
claims.call: The Flyers get at least their usual 7.7% of their 5-on-5 chances right after winning the puck.
claims.body: Almost nobody punishes turnovers like the Flyers, and the Kraken give the puck away in bad spots.
claims.nums: Philadelphia 5th for chances off turnovers (7.7% of their chances come right after winning the puck) · Seattle 29th for avoiding breakdowns
claims.gist: The Flyers pounce on loose pucks, and the Kraken cough them up.

claims.head: Bruisers against finesse
claims.body: On physicality, Philadelphia is near the top of the league and Seattle is near the bottom of the league. That’s about as far apart as two teams get.
claims.gist: The Flyers and the Kraken sit at opposite ends for physicality.
claims.call: The Flyers hit more than the Kraken in the close stretches of the game.

PHI.head: Leaning Philadelphia’s way
PHI.body: Philadelphia has had more of the chances over recent games and has home ice. Not by much, though: Seattle can make it interesting if they keep dangerous shots away.

SEA.head: Seattle starts a half-step behind
